meta.name: FDA Complete Response Letters, one row per distinct letter
meta.licence_note: The letters are the FDA's (public domain). This table, its cleaning and its joins are pdufa.bio's, under CC BY 4.0: cite pdufa.bio and link the page.
rules: Only records the FDA typed COMPLETE RESPONSE; tentative approvals, refusals to file, provisional determinations, rescissions and untyped records are left out.
A record repeats another when its letter date, application numbers and text are the same; it is kept once.

rescinded_by_fda is true where the FDA's own rescission letter names the letter as issued in error; rescission_date is that rescission letter's date. /crl/facts keeps them in its total and its yearly table and leaves them out of its repeat and letter-to-approval counts; /feed leaves them out.
openfda_approval_status is the release's own approval_status field, as printed.

company_group is the company's group on /crl/companies: printed names are grouped with case, accents, punctuation and corporate-form words set aside, and the group is labeled with its most common printed form. Blank where the release prints a heading or a bare corporate-form word in place of a name (no lower-case letter).

orange_book_nda_first_approval_after_letter: the earliest approval the Orange Book products file lists for the NDA, when that date is after the letter (original NDAs only; the earliest such NDA when a letter names several), with orange_book_trade_name its trade name. Blank for BLAs (not in the Orange Book), supplements, NDAs with no listed approval, and NDAs whose first listed approval is on or before the letter's date (the NDA was already approved, or approved the same day), even when other products under that NDA were approved later.

deficiency_sections: the letter's own section headings read from its PDF text layer, labeling and administrative sections left out; only 2024+ letters whose PDF holds this letter alone; blank when none was read.
pdufa_bio_page: pdufa.bio's decision page that cites this letter's PDF, when exactly one indexable page does and the PDF holds this letter alone; blank otherwise.
In the CSV, booleans are true or false, and a text cell that starts with = + - or @ is written with a leading apostrophe so a spreadsheet shows it as text; the JSON keeps every value as printed.
meta.not_advice: Facts from FDA documents. Not a prediction about any application and not investment advice.
